name: Kaeru Batake DE Tsukamaete☆
original_name: カエル畑DEつかまえて☆彡
source:
"It all started when we broke that shrine."

Sugano Fuu is a 1st year student who goes to Tsukiyado High School.

One day she along with her upperclassman Norizuki and her classmate Hirose decided to investigate the "Seven Mysteries of Tsukiyado" as part of their club activities.

It wasn't a particularly interesting topic to find information on, they were just wasting time.
"Ah, There's a weird shrine at our school isn't there. Why don't we go investigate?"
In that kind of noncommittal fashion they went to look into it.

At the shrine Hamura and Kuga were waiting.
They weren't really on good terms with those two, they were more like complete strangers.
With a quick greeting the investigation started.

The shrine was pretty old and even though it wasn't locked the door wouldn't open.
It seemed like it was rusted shut, when they tried to pry the doors open they quickly crumbled.
Within that dirty rubble they saw "something".
As they blankly gazed at that "something" suddenly smoke started pouring out.

"What if it's poison gas!!"

With all their might they threw the "something" as far away as they could.
But after all that they were still enveloped in the smoke coming from that "something". And before they knew it they were transformed into frogs.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.takuyo.co.jp/products/kaerubatake/story.html]official site[/url].]
translation:
"一切都始于我们弄坏那座神社。"

菅野风羽是月宿高中一年级学生。

一天，她与学长法月、同班同学广濑决定在社团活动中调查"月宿七大不可思议"。

这个题目并没有多么有趣，他们不过是在打发时间。
"啊，学校里不是有座奇怪的神社吗？要不要去调查一下？"
众人就这样随意地决定前去查看。

羽村和空闲正在神社等候。他们与这两人关系并不好，几乎和陌生人没什么区别。简单打过招呼后，调查开始了。

神社十分古老。门虽然没有上锁，却怎么也打不开，似乎已经锈死。众人试图强行撬门，门板很快便碎裂开来。他们在肮脏的残骸中看见了"某样东西"。正当众人茫然注视着它时，烟雾突然涌出。

"要是毒气怎么办！！"

他们拼尽全力把那"东西"扔向远处，却依旧被它冒出的烟雾笼罩。等回过神来，所有人都变成了青蛙。

[翻译自[url=http://www.takuyo.co.jp/products/kaerubatake/story.html]官方网站[/url]。]
